In Hinduism, prosperity, happiness, and contentment are considered essential aspects of a balanced and meaningful life. Giving a child the name Santosh is a way of celebrating this joy and contentment experienced by the parents. It reflects the positive and enriching aspects of Hindu culture, which emphasizes the importance of inner peace and satisfaction.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Santosh holds a deep spiritual significance in Hinduism. It is a reminder that true happiness and satisfaction come from within, and not from external sources.
